Thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed redwood-msadpa-draft.pdf and pulled a few items that matter for sequencing:

1) Data Processing Addendum (DPA) redlines that change data export or subprocessor rules are blockers and must be resolved before order form signature.
2) Standard indemnity/limitation edits can be handled as contract play (parallel) provided commercial terms are agreed.
3) If Helio requires an audit clause beyond our SOC 2 attestations, that needs a short procurement approval (2–3 business days) and will push the signature path.

Action items I propose:
- Helio to flag any DPA clauses they consider mandatory blockers by EOD Thu 2026-04-09.
- Redwood to produce a clean redline and an executive summary of outstanding legal risk by Fri 2026-04-10.
